root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: The stylesheet preprocessor must still descend into `cur->children` for the template subtree even when the first child is an entity-reference node.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `xsltPreprocessStylesheet()` reaches the witness template's child list, it must continue into `cur->children` instead of treating an `XML_ENTITY_REF_NODE` first child as a reason to skip the whole subtree; otherwise the later siblings remain unvisited and not internalized.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reports `descend_allowed = 0` at the template child-walk while the later stylesheet cleanup still executes. The fixed original reaches the same template site with `descend_allowed = 1` and the later stylesheet cleanup still executes cleanly.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: Vulnerable assertion trace: `preprocess_template_descend.descend_allowed = 0` before `stylesheet_doc_cleanup`. Fixed assertion trace: `preprocess_template_descend.descend_allowed = 1` with `stylesheet_doc_cleanup` still reached.

nodes.state: At the single-text `xsl:attribute` fast path, the temporary attribute uses the original stylesheet text buffer as its content pointer via `copyTxt->content = inst->children->content`.
Immediately before `xmlFreeNode(insert)`, the temporary message node is about to free an attribute-text child whose content pointer is the original stylesheet text buffer.

`xsltFreeStylesheet` later reaches `xmlFreeDoc(style->doc)` on the same stylesheet document that still owns the original text node; this project-side cleanup call enters the downstream libxml2 `xmlFreeNodeList` double-free sink reported by ASan.

edges.relation: The original stylesheet text buffer selected by the `xsl:attribute` fast path becomes the content pointer freed when `xsltEvalTemplateString` tears down the temporary message node.

After the temporary message-node free releases the aliased text buffer, `xsltFreeStylesheet` later frees the same stylesheet document, re-entering libxml2 cleanup on the owner object that still contains that original text node.
edges.evidence: Vulnerable assertion trace shows `message_insert_free.stylesheet_doc == stylesheet_doc_cleanup.style_doc == 0x60f000000130` with ordered events 2 -> 3.
